component-o.description-s: USB Type-C 2.0 receptacle, 16 contacts, surface mount, right angle, 5 A / 20 V, 10000 cycles; board power input (VBUS/GND, CC1/CC2 with 5.1k Rd pull-downs for a sink, D+/D- brought out)

mate-o.frame_s: the board connector's footprint frame; the model is built there, so offset and rotation are zero
mate-o.source_s: USB Type-C plug, generic: shell 8.3 x 2.4 mm inserted 6.5 mm, overmold 12.0 x 6.5 x 25 mm (the USB-C spec's overmold envelope is 12.35 x 6.5), 4 mm cable 15 mm. The overmold reaches 1.65 mm below the board's top: the jack must sit at the board edge

connector-o.shell_tht_source_s: four plated through-hole slot tabs for the shell (footprint pads 1-4, thru_hole oval, 0.8 x 1.2 / 1.5 mm slots; HRO TYPE-C-31-M-12 drawing); signal contacts SMD
connector-o.board_area_note_s: courtyard (right-angle at the board edge: the mate overhangs the edge)
connector-o.fields_source_s: 5 A / 20 V per the HRO sheet = 1.25 A on each of the 4 VBUS / 4 GND contacts

component-o.footprint-note-s: 2026-10-17: the four 0.6 mm power pads (A1B12, A4B9, B4A9, B1A12) were EasyEDA custom polygons with a 0.1 mm outline stroke, making them 0.7 mm wide and leaving 0.100 mm between A1B12 and A4B9 (under a 4 mil fab minimum). Replaced by plain 0.60 x 1.30 mm rects at the same centres, as the datasheet RECOMMEND P.C.B LAYOUT gives (4-0.60, 0.80 pitch): minimum pad gap now 0.200 mm.

stdpins-ao.A8: SBU1, unused for a power sink

stdpins-ao.B8: SBU2, unused for a power sink

component-o.notes-s: CC1/CC2: USB-C sink must present Rd = 5.1k to GND on each CC pin or a Type-C source keeps VBUS off; the 5.1k-avss shorthands place them. The CC voltage also tells the sink the source's current (default, 1.5 A or 3 A).
